notes.title: December 2024
notes.content:
Greetings, comrades.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/35280558/9760652e58f128f59776eef46c2b84e66f99236b.jpg[/img]

As the year draws to a close, here’s a quick rundown. Before you tune out, let me present the agenda—maybe one of the topics will catch your interest, and you can jump straight to it:

1. **Priest Simulator**  
2. **Mercyful Flames**  
3. **Taxi Simulator**  
4. **Your Principal**  

[h1]Priest Simulator[/h1]

Our most recognized franchise so far is keeping us busy:

The **Vampire Show** has left Early Access. However, we’ve already received feedback about some messed-up lipsync and issues with the final raid not registering correctly. We’ve fixed the first problem, and we’re working on the second. A patch is on its way.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2947900/Priest_Simulator_Her_Ghost_DLC/

We’ve released *Her Ghost*, a DLC for *Vampire Show*, offering about an hour of new gameplay. Some of you may remember that we declared the game finished months ago, but for various reasons, the launch was delayed. Sure, any game can be endlessly improved, so we added a few more cards to the Trello board. Plus, we wanted to experiment with creating DLC, so we decided to add new content roughly on the scale of *Heavy Duty*. Big thanks to everyone who purchased it.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/35280558/a600c086e2e6a9d8b55b48b80c2334850957a4b6.jpg[/img]

We also made the soundtrack available some time ago. You can listen to it on Spotify or YouTube. The music video for the standout track *Legion* is doing pretty well at festivals:

- Winner: Best Polish Animated Music Video at PL Music Video Awards 2024  
- Winner: *Black Horse of Music Videos* at Ars Independent 2024  
- Semi-finalist: Azyl Shorts 2024  

It was also officially selected for:  
Animakom Fest 2024,  
Żubroffka 2024 (Music Video category),  
Animest 2024,  
Splat!FilmFest 2024,  
Grand Video Awards 2024 (Music Video category),  
Offeliada 2024,  
Linoleum 2024.  

Watch it here:  
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oMop-7BM4ds  

That’s not all the news from the *Priest* universe. We’ve been working for months on the next installment, *Wolf Moon*. It continues threads from the previous games but takes them in a very different direction. It’s a low-poly action RPG inspired by MOBAs and *Vampire Survivors*. We intended to release the Steam page this year, but it’s not yet up to our standards.

[h1]Mercyful Flames[/h1]

We’ve really gone all out on this one. Last year, we made the tough decision to rework the game completely—a decision that was challenging but ultimately necessary. The original concept of a card-based RPG might resurface in a future project, but not here. *Mercyful Flames* always had great atmosphere but struggled with the transition of our physical designs into a digital format. 

This time, we went all in, inspired by a friend’s comment: “I’d buy a *Priest* game that’s just cutscenes.” While it’s an oversimplification, it nudged us toward creating a minimalist, gameplay-light experience.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/35280558/9f43649f9c317bbbe19503dc7c6f5949339f975b.jpg[/img]

The game is going through what feels like its hundredth iteration. I admit I’ve gone a bit obsessive, tweaking every little detail. We keep adding minor dialogues or effects to enhance the illusion of a living world. The game is divided into dozens of “scenes,” and polishing one often makes others look subpar in comparison. At that point, we have to even things out, one way or another.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1066740/Mercyful_Flames_The_Witches/

As with *Vulgator*, we’ve collaborated with acclaimed Polish artists. This time, we worked with *Alembik*, a duo comprising Robert and Michał. You might know Michał from *Owls Woods Graves*, *Over the Voids*, and *Mgła* (live). They composed the soundtrack, which will also be available as a standalone album on streaming platforms.

[h1]Taxi Simulator[/h1]

Now for our biggest project. We’ve been dedicating our lives to this one and regularly post devlogs about its progress. The game has a completely different vibe from anything we’ve done before—less experimental, more craftsmanship. This time, the title isn’t some ironic twist; it’s exactly what it says.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1159390/Taxi_Simulator/

**Your Principal** is temporarily on hold by mutual agreement with the publisher. We’ll return to it next year.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1176330/Your_Principal/

Apart from these titles, we’re also working on a port—or rather, a remaster—of a certain hit, but we’re not revealing any details yet.

By the way, you might have read rumors that we’re quitting game development to start selling weapons. Some reliable Polish media outlets got their facts and companies mixed up. I won’t bother denying it because it works in our favor.

notes.title: And deliver us from Early Access
notes.content:
We've thanked you a few times already, but there's no such thing as too many thank-yous. So here it is again: thank you for being part of, let’s not kid ourselves, the most important adventure of our professional lives. It’s still a bit too early for a proper postmortem where we could dive into all the highs and lows, but that moment will definitely come. We've been working on this project for... I don’t even know how long anymore, probably around six years, and honestly, it might be Priest that influenced us more than we influenced Priest.

It’s been amazing that so many of you played and reviewed the game, streamed it, created art, did cosplays, listened to Gruzja, had fun with us on social media, and that I got to meet so many of you in person—especially at concerts. Asmodev is still here because of you ready to work on new projects. Life is sad and meaningless, and yet you still managed to smile. Bravo to you, you freaks.

[h2]Her Ghost DLC[/h2]
Free is the best price but unfortunately we have to live (promise, it won't last long), so it's just cheap. [i]Her Ghost is an add-on containing a quest that continues the events of Vampire Show. Kinda funny, seriously cringe, one of a kind. That is, it's one of a kind in the same way as Heavy Duty and Vampire Show, which makes it one-third of a kind.[/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2947900/Priest_Simulator_Her_Ghost_DLC/

[h2]Priest Simulator: Vampire Show | Full Release Changelog[/h2]
[h3]Added/New[/h3]
[list][*] Added the raid quest
[*] Added the meeting in the church basement
[*] Added particles for car kills
[*] Added missing VO
[*] Added sound effects to the basement
[*] Added a sound effect for collecting offerings
[*] Added particles to the baseball bat
[*] Added new character models
[*] Added collision to Wickerman’s backpack
[*] Added your photos in balaclavas
[*] Added lip-sync for Satanists
[*] Added Kremuva retrospectives and the associated quest
[*] Added a few cutscenes to clarify the story
[*] Added translations for tutorials
[*] Added the ability to mark all exorcisms on the map
[*] New: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2947900/Priest_Simulator_Her_Ghost_DLC/]Her Ghost DLC[/url][/list]
[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list][*] Improved door textures
[*] Improved enemy weapon particles
[*] Improved the wheel menu cheat sheet
[*] Optimized game saving[/list]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list][*] Modified the cutscene of Diabolina converting the Christianists
[*] Modified LODs
[*] Adjusted NPC spawn points to be consistent with cutscenes
[*] Changed triggers that activate cutscenes[/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list][*] Fixed the acetylene cutscene
[*] Fixed NPCs holding items
[*] Fixed menu links
[*] Fixed overlapping audio tracks
[*] Fixed collisions in the church
[*] Fixed object disappearance bugs
[*] Fixed an issue where Torpedo woke up too early, making the funeral quest nonsensical
[*] Fixed the exorcism win/lose system, which could break the game
[*] Fixed animation glitches in many cutscenes
[*] Fixed glitches on Orlok's mask
[*] Fixed a bug where Melissa would leave the table and start wandering
[*] Fixed task tracking after completing an exorcism
[*] Resolved a potential game lock in the "French Connection" quest
[*] Resolved the disappearing Vamela bug after the first exorcism quest
[*] Resolved an issue with the missing task to change the time[/list]
[h3]Other[/h3]
[list][*] Disabled radio at the start of the game
[*] Blocked the ability to spin the slot machine again after winning a prize
[*] Enabled access to the haunted house next to the casino
[*] Extended the exorcism ending screen display[/list]
[h3]Removed[/h3]
[list][*] Removed a lock that sometimes remained after the cannon cutscene
[*] Removed an invisible collision near the bakery
[*] Removed the ability to reset attack animations[/list]

In addition to the changes listed above, we decided not to include (in the list, not patch) over 1,000 fixes and tweaks because, honestly, nobody would read through them all. We're talking about thrilling stuff like fixing typos, tweaking voice-over sounds, and zapping micro-bugs that would make even the most devout patch note reader lose faith. Yes, we could have listed every corrected “i before e” and every adjustment to the subtle hum of NPC whispers but we figured you’d rather enjoy the game than scroll through a list longer than the Book of Psalms. You're welcome.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33753789/d903391deab7559efad8b5d48f8f06cc44d5570a.jpg[/img]

If something doesn't sit well with you, feel free to file a complaint—preferably right under this post. We're leaving Early Access, but we're always (un)happy to fix what needs fixing.

notes.content:

Hello. We're launching a Halloween sale, celebrating the most beautiful holiday of the year, and with it, we're introducing a new name. Hopefully, this will stop you from confusing the game with Heavy Duty. And perhaps it'll be easier to click, you know, because of the vampire in the name. And maybe those who complain that the priest doesn't have his faculties will finally back off. GREETINGS, BOOZE MASTERS.

- get rid of holes in the ground.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33753789/b6d59b4bc8c2b0dd96a6413340c366bebf122931.jpg[/img]

Hello, dear kremuvkers :).

It's been greasy lately. You have already crossed the threshold of 400 reviews and almost all of them to Melissa's color <3 ːsteamthumbsupː.

notes.title: Robbin HUD
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33753789/d7b585505581b983ee3a9fa09c37c68ba1e411cf.jpg[/img]

Why the hell am I showing you this boring view? Because I want you to focus on our super innovative HUD that we've stolen from other games. It can tell you a lot about [i]Priest's[/i] features.

1. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33753789/3579c6a1555b1277c7559815e684c6eed8208b72.jpg[/img]

We've got quest objectives. Because the person who took the screenshot (me) is a brainless monkey, currently there are no active quests selected, so the hint hints there are no active quests selected. Pity, because the quest objectives are the worst thing in the whole game, you're gonna love it.

2.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33753789/c3f8bf77c668342b1ebd993259ae1d4635dccc33.jpg[/img]

CompAss. This thing can show you N, E, S and W. Hope you'll use it a lot.

3. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33753789/10e5ddaaee3c93f10b30808d9364e61d47c450fa.jpg[/img]

We call it [i]Zaibatsu[/i], because it works just like respect indicators in GTA2. There are God worshipers and Devil worshipers. Please whoever you wish, piss off whoever you wish, and look how those beauties dance. Magic.

4. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33753789/4e1b5682b41d9ed0097ec1d3f6d48d2b1aa66281.jpg[/img]

Crosshair. We've deleted cross not to offend anyone's religious feelings.

5. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33753789/9707f7482bafaab42d6c4309e19fb64d2c964be1.jpg[/img]

Resources. For trading and crafting. You know, just like in all those games like [i]Fortnite[/i] that nobody plays.

6. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33753789/c220013990b1d2f51190753bf5f3caf195881547.jpg[/img]

HP and Divine Power indicators. God only knows what those things are for.

7. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33753789/b98e4ccfe2a45d54884703f26c84a1b939816025.jpg[/img]

Ok. I know the feeling. It is the real thing. You see, it shows your left hand equipment, and right hand equipment... Because you can use both hands. On a left click, and on a right click (and no, not X, and Y on a pad, just forgot to switch it in a test build ːsteamfacepalmː). Separately. Simultaneously. However you like it. Whatever works. Amen.
